profile.rubric: product, game-loop, realism, rendered-pixel, security, and release gates
profile.staging: Commit the exact candidate, deploy and verify it on stable Cloudflare staging, then promote the same revision to production.
profile.source: Session 97 local status plus live repository and provider evidence

gameLoopReview.evidence: The 30-second, five-minute, season, and dynasty contracts remain visibly implemented and deeply regression-covered. The audit found two truth/interaction seams inside those loops: a tie can vanish from the record a player reads, and the phone commit control can fall below a long pressure stack. Retention stays evidence-limited because no genuine opted-in cohort exists.

feature-depth.evidence: The engine models ties, while multiple player-facing record strings and deltas retain only wins and losses.
The recorded creative-direction boundary still requires founder direction; this arc will not invent the ending.

new-innovative-features.evidence: A sticky, safe-area-aware commit dock preserves the one-call loop without adding a second mobile product.
The deterministic Co-GM and film surfaces already explain live receipts; a hosted model adds cost and unverifiable causality without demand evidence.

ui-ux.evidence: .mobile-loop-overlay is fixed to every viewport edge but uses plain 1rem padding, and .ml-actions follows every optional pressure and decision card rather than staying reachable.
The 768px drawer is already hash-bound, scrollable, and parity-tested; the reproduced gap is the phone decision deck, not tablet reachability.

feedback-loop.evidence: Return boundaries store wins/losses only and recordChanged ignores ties, so a real tied game can disappear from the welcome-back explanation.
Aggregate page loads are not users, sessions, retention, or an opted-in cohort.

gamification-engagement.evidence: The perfect-start achievement does not require zero ties, and the season epilogue evaluates and displays a wins/losses-only season.
The public GAME_LOOP contract keeps mastery descriptive and forbids invented causal bonuses.

ai-integration.evidence: Co-GM, tactical film, consequences, season thesis, and exact navigation already expose explainable source receipts.
No cost-neutral demand signal exists, and deterministic narratives better preserve replay and evidence boundaries.

security.candidate: mobile landmark and notch-safe action surface
security.evidence: The named mobile overlay has no landmark role and can place controls under device cutouts because it lacks safe-area padding.
No account flows exist; external Obelisk remains the declared identity boundary.

speed-organization-efficiency.evidence: Running the mandated startup renderer changed PROJECT_STATUS.lastUpdated from 2026-08-27 to 2026-09-01 solely because doctor --update-json uses the default touch behavior.
The rail already has five task groups; changing information architecture does not follow from the reproduced phone action-reachability defect.

token-api-reduction.candidate: truthful activity age prevents false recovery work
token-api-reduction.evidence: An automatic Active 0d signal conceals the real six-day closeout age and can suppress the exact freshness investigation startup exists to trigger.
Cloudflare aggregate reporting is already repeatable; another vendor would duplicate data and cost.

items.category: Feature depth · feedback loop · engagement · truth
items.title: A real tied game vanishes from records, return deltas, achievements, and some win-rate decisions
items.premise: The simulator and standings carry ties, but mobileLoop, franchiseNewsletter, rewardBeats, gameFlow, tabOverview, betaFeedback, returnDigest, and seasonEpilogue display or persist only wins/losses. returnDigest.recordChanged ignores tie deltas; perfect-start accepts 5-0-1; seasonEpilogue and three server/difficulty paths compute win rate without ties.
items.fix: Create one browser record-truth authority for lookup, formatting, and half-win percentage; migrate player-facing consumers and tie-only deltas, then align server/local fan sentiment and adaptive difficulty with focused negative controls.

L1.recipe: Add ties to the most visible record strings and the return boundary.

L2.recipe: Create a shared browser record helper, migrate every reproduced player-facing consumer, make tie-only return movement visible, and correct achievement/season percentage logic with focused tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus align local/server fan sentiment and adaptive difficulty, add cross-surface negative controls, and prove a 5-0-1 season never renders or scores as 5-0.

items.title: A read-oriented startup health refresh rewrites project activity age to today
items.premise: render-startup-brief runs doctor --update-json; doctor calls updateProjectStatus without touchLastUpdated:false; the shared writer therefore changed lastUpdated from 2026-08-27 to 2026-09-01 before any S97 product work and the brief reported Active 0d.
items.fix: Keep doctorScore current without touching the product-state timestamp, and pin the invariant with a regression that compares lastUpdated before and after doctor --update-json.

L2.recipe: Isolate doctor receipt freshness from project activity and add a before/after regression around the real command path.

L3.recipe: L2 plus audit other automated status writers for the same semantic leak and make startup activity age derive only from substantive authorities.

items.title: The phone decision deck can place its commit below a long scroll and under device safe areas
items.premise: .mobile-loop-overlay is a fixed full-screen surface with plain 1rem padding and no safe-area variables. .ml-actions renders after trophy road, the architect objective, every pressure card, and the decision deck; the named overlay has no region role.
items.fix: Make the overlay four-edge safe-area aware, turn the action row into a readable sticky command dock, add a named region landmark, and prove dark/light mobile pixels plus focus/touch behavior.

L2.recipe: Add four-edge safe-area padding, a sticky action dock with opaque theme-correct backing, a named region, and focused static/browser assertions.

L3.recipe: L2 plus inspect dark/light 390px and 430px rendered states with a maximal pressure stack and bind the receipt to the release candidate.

phantomsRejected.evidence: Aggregate page paths do not identify users, sessions, returns, comprehension, or retention.
Deterministic intelligence already covers the decision loop and no cost-neutral demand signal exists.
Existing 768px rendered and browser evidence proves the drawer keeps the full game reachable.
Deployment authorization does not prove reply-as email, lifecycle authority, external Obelisk registration, cohort evidence, or public-launch approval.
The reproduced problem is action placement inside the phone deck; the existing section rail is already grouped.

recommendedMoves: Make every football record and percentage tie-complete, from simulation judgement through the return digest and shareable season card.
Separate health-receipt freshness from substantive project activity so startup cannot make a stale project look active.
Keep the phone's one decisive commit reachable above device cutouts and long pressure stacks.
